checks.title: Formulaic negative contrast
checks.message: Express the actual functions and their relation directly. Check quoted or fixed technical wording before changing it.

checks.title: Prohibited phrase: not merely
checks.message: Remove the rhetorical template and state the substantive relation.

checks.title: Prohibited phrase: not only
checks.message: State each substantive contribution in direct clauses.

checks.title: Prohibited phrase: rather than
checks.message: Express the relevant functions or conditions directly.

checks.title: Prohibited phrase: instead of
checks.message: Describe the actual procedure or choice directly.

checks.title: Prohibited phrase: as opposed to
checks.message: Name the distinction and its relevant dimension.

checks.title: Formulaic temporal negative contrast
checks.message: State the actual change without a binary rhetorical template.

checks.title: Translated negative-contrast template
checks.message: Apply the same positive-relation policy to the translated rhetorical construction.

checks.title: Template purpose or argument announcement
checks.message: Begin with the substantive object and claim.

checks.title: Writing-process announcement
checks.message: Replace an itinerary with the relation that motivates the next argument.

checks.title: Promotional or empty evaluative claim
checks.message: Identify the supported result. Necessary quoted or technical language requires human review.

checks.title: Possible unsupported hierarchy
checks.message: Check whether the comparison states a shared dimension and a supported difference.

checks.title: Potentially unclear demonstrative
checks.message: Resolve the antecedent; a clear contextual referent may justify keeping the phrase.

checks.title: Stacked uncertainty words
checks.message: Locate the actual source of uncertainty and preserve the supported force.

checks.title: Possible plural subject agreement error
checks.message: Check the grammatical head and the verb. The pattern covers only narrow cases.

checks.title: Possible article or countability error
checks.message: Check countability and the intended noun phrase in context.

checks.title: Repeated adjacent word
checks.message: Remove an accidental duplicate; a repeated grammatical word can occasionally be intentional.

checks.title: Semicolon-separated citation cluster
checks.message: Distribute distinct citations across their claims, preserving the required citation style.

checks.title: More than two works in a parenthesis
checks.message: Keep a parenthetical group small and functionally unified.

checks.title: Five or more cited positions in a paragraph
checks.message: Reorganize the paragraph into coherent argument units. The citation count is heuristic.

checks.title: Possible author-by-author literature sequence
checks.message: Organize the paragraph around a problem and the relation among source contributions.
